_doc: Device catalog. WebUI / in-app Devices tab fetches this (locally now, later from a GitHub release raw URL) to list supported devices and download their definitions. 'url' is relative to this catalog's location, or an absolute https URL. 'capabilities' is the full RE'd count; 'injectable' is how many render natively on the Pixel About page; 'verified' is how many have hardware-confirmed bytes.
